title: Aria Research Backs First AI Agent Teams With £50M Scaling Trust Fund
summary:
A selection of researchers and developers has been chosen to build open-source infrastructure that allows AI agents to coordinate securely in physical and digital environments. Aria Research selected these teams, referred to as 'Creators,' to conduct fundamental research that enables AI agents to operate reliably on behalf of users as part of its £50 million Scaling Trust programme.

The organization states that this secure coordination will unlock economically and socially valuable interactions that were previously inaccessible to autonomous systems. Scaling Trust is accepting applications for new teams on a rolling basis, with the next submission deadline on Oct 31.
